title: Swap Two Numbers
statement: Swap two numbers without using a third variable.
inputOutputContract: Input two signed integers; output their values in swapped order, no third temporary variable. Avoid signed-overflow-prone implementations.

mistakes.hint1: Inspect the overwrites right with left behavior in swapWithoutTemporary; the current algorithm is close, but one operation changes its result.
mistakes.hint2: Start by tracing T1 manually. Watch array indices / comparisons / loop boundaries / return values at each iteration or recursive return.
mistakes.hint3: Check the invariant of swapWithoutTemporary: Perform the XOR swap in all three stages without aliasing the two locations.
mistakes.hint4: Concentrate on the expression or branch that controls this mistake: `*right = *left;`. What does it do on the failing input?
mistakes.hint5: Compare the intermediate state with the expected output of T1. The mistake is in overwrites right with left, not merely formatting.
mistakes.hint6: Adjust the faulty operation so that it follows this rule: Perform the XOR swap in all three stages without aliasing the two locations.
mistakes.hint7: A targeted correction is to replace `*right = *left;` with `*right ^= *left;` in swapWithoutTemporary, then retest T1–T6.
